win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 14. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: WILD EYEBALL SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
When an EyeBall symbol lands, it can only land on the 4th row of the grid. Once the grid has settled, all EyeBall symbols shoot in 1 of 3 directions: straight up, diagonally left, or diagonally right. EyeBall symbols activate in order from left to right.

 When an EyeBall shoots, every paying symbol along its path transforms into a Wild symbol. These transformed symbols can remain Wild or reveal an Additive Multiplier value. Wild symbols substitute for all symbols in the paytable. Multiplier values revealed on Wild symbols can be: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 If an EyeBall symbol hits an existing Wild symbol, that Wild symbol gains a Multiplier value. If an EyeBall symbol hits a Wild symbol with a Multiplier, the Multiplier value of that Wild will increase by adding a new Multiplier value to the existing Wild Multiplier. Multiplier values added to Wild symbols can be: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 Activated EyeBall symbols transform into Wild symbols. If more than 1 Wild Multiplier symbol is part of the same winning combination, the values are first added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: ENERGY FIELDS
wilds.behavior:
There are 3 Energy Fields located on the left, top, and right edges of the grid. If an EyeBall symbol activates and hits an Energy Field, the EyeBall will bounce off the Energy Field and continue in another direction at the same angle. The EyeBall symbol will continue to transform paying symbols in its path into Wild symbols.

 When an EyeBall symbol hits a Energy Field straight on, the EyeBall will bounce back the same way it came from, adding Multiplier values to the transformed Wild symbols. If an EyeBall hits an EyeBall symbol, it adds a Multiplier value.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - IT’S ELECTRIFYING
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the NO-BRAINER bonus. In addition, at least one EyeBall symbol will land on every free spin! FS symbols cannot land in this bonus.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols cannot land at the same time as EyeBall symbols.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - EYECONIC
modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics, with an increased chance of landing EyeBall symbols!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins

modes.name: BONUS GAME - NO-BRAINER
modes.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the EYECONIC bonus. In addition each EyeBall symbol that activates will shoot in two different directions on one spin!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins
